svg.aria-label: What each system's loop refused: ConvFinQA rejected seven of nine gate verdicts and rolled back three earlier champions; Transcript RAG shipped one of eight ablation configurations; Data Pilot shipped two of three eval cycles and holds thirty of thirty-two golden cases in draft.
svg.title: A loop earns its keep by refusing, not by promoting

g.title: ConvFinQA Agent · nine gate verdicts on the same 349 unseen questions · two promoted, seven rejected, and three earlier champions un-promoted on 2026-09-03 when the rule got stricter
Transcript RAG · an eight-configuration ablation over the same twenty golden entries · one configuration ships, and every committed run is re-scored by CI
Data Pilot · three eval cycles, of which 002 failed and was not shipped · and 30 of the 32 golden cases are still draft rather than promoted to ready
